about: Every still, satellite image and clip in the pitch video (video/pitch.mjs), with its source, licence and the exact attribution. video/pitch-media.mjs prepares them into video/.out/pitch/ (stills resized, clips cut to frame sequences). 'src' is the downloaded file name; 'url' is the direct file. Kind: REAL = the actual event or its aftermath, PLACE = the real place, GENERIC = stand-in footage (never captioned as a specific event).
